source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Errata to the second paragraph of the Immolator's Transport section. As the Declare Battle Formations step begins, you may pick 1 **BATTLE SISTERS SQUAD**, **DOMINION SQUAD** or **SISTERS NOVITIATE SQUAD** of yours and split it into 2 units with model counts as equal as possible, noting which models form each. After the split:

- if the unit had the Cherub ability, only 1 new unit may use it in the battle, and you note which
- 1 new unit must begin the battle inside this **TRANSPORT**
- the other may begin inside another **TRANSPORT** or be deployed on its own

split.timing: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

embark.firstUnit: must start embarked within this TRANSPORT
